53
Classifier-free Guidance → sample quality higher
OpenAI's GLIDE model, without guidance (left) and with guidance (right)
Slide credit to: https://www.practical-diﬀusion.org/

54
What is Classifier-free Guidance “doing”? 
CFG is a predictor corrector, Bradley and Nakkiran, 2024, and Guiding a Diffusion 
Model with a Bad Version of Itself, Karras et al. 2024
 
Theory is still developing but empirically:
1.
Increasing guidance 𝛾 leads to sharper “low-temperature” 
sampling (i.e. higher density regions of distribution contain 
higher perceived quality samples)
2.
Learned score functions tend to have more signiﬁcant error in 
low density regions, and so this error is less apparent with 
guidance
Guidance Strength
